name: xv6 filesystem study & small kernel-space FS

mentions.name: xv6 filesystem study & small kernel-space FS
mentions.description: A personal self-study project re-examining the xv6 teaching operating system's filesystem, then studying other filesystems and the VFS virtual layer that sits on top of filesystems, with a possible follow-up of implementing a very small filesystem in kernel space. Pursued purely for personal enjoyment, unrelated to the author's work.
mentions.source_excerpt: Going back to xv6 to re-study its filesystem, and then study other filesystems, and then study VFS the virtual layer on top of filesystems, and then maybe implement a very small FS in kernel space.
